data.one_liner: Automatic hot code reloader for Dart projects that applies file changes to the running process.
data.what_it_does: Monitors the source files of a Dart project on the local file system for changes. Automatically applies code changes to the running Dart process using the Dart VM's hot reload capabilities.
use_when: You want to enable hot reload for non-Flutter Dart projects (such as command-line tools or servers).
You want faster iteration cycles during backend or CLI Dart development.
avoid_when: You are building standard Flutter apps, which already have built-in hot reload support.
strengths: Automates hot reloading for plain Dart processes.
Supports watching dependencies based on package graph and monorepos.
Configurable debounce intervals and hooks for before and after reload.
weaknesses: Requires the Dart VM service to be enabled via command-line flags.
Development-only utility not intended for production usage.
data.setup_notes: Add hotreloader as a dev dependency and start your Dart program with the --enable-vm-service flag.
